text:
**Dark mode is now available to everyone**

As of May 12, every user has dark mode. To switch it on, go to your settings. It's easier on the eyes if you do a lot of writing late at night.

You asked for this one. In the beta, 38% of testers requested dark mode, more than asked for anything else. We didn't want to just flip the colors, so we took longer and did it properly.

We started with readability. Dark mode text has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which meets the WCAG AAA standard for normal text. A short grocery list or several pages of meeting notes will both be clear and easy to read. We also adjusted headings, links, highlights and code blocks so they still stand out on the darker background.

You can pick dark mode or light mode. You can also have the app follow your device's system setting, so it switches on its own through the day.

Thanks to everyone who tried the early builds and sent us feedback. Please keep it coming. A lot of our best features started as your suggestions.
